evidence_against: The registry labels 16 candidates MATURED_SUPPORTED, but supplies no candidate-level scores, baseline comparisons, effect sizes or regime results. Supportive lifecycle labels do not establish incremental predictive value.
The weekly adjudication assigns 207 of 423 candidates ARCHIVE_ONLY_DUPLICATE and 164 WAIT_FOR_MORE_PROSPECTIVE_EVIDENCE. Repeated or overlapping tests cannot be counted as independent confirmations.

Several BTC swap mark-price RANGE candidates are supported, while other candidates with the same broad title are MATURED_NOT_SUPPORTED. Titles omit the specifications needed to determine whether their results conflict or represent distinct tests.
Weekly escalation receipts include both REPLICATED_FIRED and REPLICATION_UNVERIFIED for some candidates; a fired replication is not evidence of independently verified replication.
The registry and weekly escalation report different matured counts for the same BTC RANGE candidate (161 versus 148). They are not a synchronized performance sample.
Protection calibration has zero eligible prospective typed rows, and the shared-row tournament is still COLLECTING with only one scorable sensor.
evidence_for: The supplied matured-outcome delta of 36 triggered an evidence-milestone review; the architecture evidence window reports 323 adjudicated outcomes over 14 days and zero censored outcomes.
The registry contains prospective BTC and ETH swap mark-price tests with multiple matured outcomes, providing subjects for adversarial comparison rather than proof of skill.
hypotheses: For a single BTC-USDT-SWAP mark-price RANGE specification frozen before new observations, test whether its out-of-sample interval score improves on a prespecified simple range baseline on the same nonduplicate, nonoverlapping prospective rows. Preregister the horizon, scoring method, controls and regime comparisons before evaluation. The hypothesis fails if improvement is absent or does not withstand the prespecified controls and regime checks.
summary: The milestone warrants scrutiny of matured evidence, not a learning claim. The analyst appropriately withheld forecasts, but supportive labels and large outcome counts may overstate information when specifications, baselines and observation independence are unavailable. One tightly specified BTC range comparison remains a research hypothesis only; no forecast candidate is issued.
uncertainties: Candidate horizons, range bounds, scoring rules and baseline results are not supplied; no numerical forecast target can be recovered from candidate titles.
The degree of overlap among matured outcomes and semantic duplicates is unknown, so counts cannot be treated as independent sample sizes.
Registry and weekly escalation snapshots differ; their candidate and outcome counts must remain separate.
Automation health is AMBER with nine amber workflows, while architecture GREEN is scoped to architecture evidence. The effect on individual outcomes is unknown.
Eight registry candidates are TARGET_UNIT_QUARANTINED; their target units cannot be inferred or repaired from their titles.
